title: ReachabilityReport
description: Body of POST /api/v1/devices/{device_id}/reachability. One reachability check run by the device on its own (on a network change, at service start, or on request): which ports/protocols toward the server get through the current network. Runs without the server's involvement, because on a restrictive network the device cannot receive commands; reports are stored on the device and uploaded once the server is reachable. Wire protocol of the reach responders: contracts/packets/reach.md.

NetworkContext.description: The network the checks ran over (the device binds every probe socket to it).

wifi_ssid.description: SSID when on Wi-Fi (needs location permission).

operator.description: Cellular operator name when on cellular.

validated.description: Android considers the network to have working internet access.

port.description: Port dialled on the server's public address.

kind.description: reach: the MPREACH1 echo (contracts/packets/reach.md). http: GET /api/v1/time on the control port.

rtt_ms.description: Round trip of the successful exchange (TCP: request→reply, not counting connect).

seen_as.description: ip:port the server saw (reach only) — differs between checks when a proxy or different NAT is in the path.

error.description: Why it failed: timeout, refused, reset, bad_reply, http_<status>, ...
